title: Fractions: Part of a Set - Word Problems
subject: Mathematics

questions.question: Tom spent 2/3 of his coins. He had 6 coins left. How many coins did he have at first?
Mary used 1/6 of a cloth to make a dress and 1/3 of the same cloth to decorate it. She had 5 m of cloth left. What was the original length of the cloth?
Alicia spent 1/3 hour to dress herself. She spent 1/2 hour more to dress her sister than herself. How long in hours did she spend in total?
questions.explanation: Time for sister = 1/3 + 1/2 = 5/6 hour. Total = 1/3 + 5/6 = 2/6 + 5/6 = 7/6 = 1 1/6 hours.

questions.question: Ben ate 1/4 of his cookies. He had 18 cookies left. How many cookies did he have at first?
A rope is 25 m long. 1/5 of it is used for tying and 2/5 of it is used for wrapping. How much rope is left?
Mary read 2/7 of a book on Monday and 3/7 of the same book on Tuesday. What fraction of the book is left to read?
A jug had 3/4 L of juice. 1/4 L was poured out. How much juice is left in the jug?
Ben ran 3/5 km in the morning and 1/5 km in the afternoon. What was the total distance he ran?
A cake was cut into 8 equal pieces. Sarah ate 3 pieces and Tom ate 2 pieces. What fraction of the cake was eaten?
Lisa had 2/3 of a pizza. She gave 1/6 of the whole pizza to her friend. How much of the pizza does Lisa have left?
A tank is 3/8 full. After adding 5/8 more of its capacity, how full is the tank?
John spent 1/4 hour on homework and 1/3 hour on reading. What was the total time he spent?
A ribbon is 12 m long. 1/3 of it is used for a bow. How much ribbon is left?
questions.explanation: Used = 1/3 of 12 = 4 m. Left = 12 - 4 = 8 m. Or: Left = 2/3 of 12 = 8 m.

questions.question: There are 30 students in a class. 2/5 of them are boys. How many boys are there?
A bottle contains 1/2 L of water. 1/4 L is drunk. How much water is left?
Amy baked a cake. She used 1/4 cup of sugar for the batter and 1/8 cup for the frosting. How much sugar did she use in total?
A piece of wire is 20 cm long. 3/5 of it is bent into a square. What length of wire is used?
There are 40 apples in a basket. 3/8 of them are red. How many red apples are there?
David walked 2/3 km to school and 1/2 km back home. What was the total distance he walked?
A jar had 5/6 L of honey. 1/3 L was used. How much honey is left?
